text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
My, you're in an awful hurry. What's the 
matter?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...――Oh dear, you lost your smartphone? 
That's quite a pickle.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, no need to rush like that. Why 
don't we take a deep breath first?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Slowly now... Deep breath in... and out... 
Yes, very good. Once more, in... and 
out...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. There, feeling a bit calmer now?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Well then. Take a good look at what's in 
that chest pocket of yours, yeah?
